narrative.synopsis: Apollo’s confidence collapses when Eros turns desire into punishment. Daphne flees the god’s pursuit and survives by losing human form, becoming the laurel Apollo can honor but not possess.
narrative.openingSituation: Apollo treats Eros’ power as lesser than his own divine archery.
narrative.centralConflict: Eros creates a cruel mismatch: Apollo burns with desire while Daphne longs only to escape.
narrative.resolution: Peneus answers Daphne’s plea by transforming her into a laurel.
narrative.outcome: Apollo keeps the laurel as sacred, while Daphne’s escape remains visible in the tree.
